summary: Path of Exile entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Path of Exile
entries.definitive_edition: Current Path of Exile 1 PC live client with league/client version documented

emulation.notes: Always-online native client; server state controls access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current live PC client with exact league/account/client state documented

primary.version: Current live Path of Exile 1 client
primary.why: Path of Exile is an always-online live ARPG, so the current PC client is the practical archive route. Historical league states, launch balance, and many seasonal mechanics cannot be recreated exactly; Path of Exile 2 is a separate game and should not replace this entry.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official or Steam PC client. Record account/realm, league, client version, build, class/ascendancy, campaign/endgame point, stash/trade/MTX visibility, controller/input, and what historical mechanics are unavailable or folded into the live game.

secondary.why: Windows PC is the best capture and documentation route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current live PC client; historical launch state no longer fully reproducible.
Live-client ports with platform-specific account/control constraints.
Evolving live-service content, with older league states changed, retired, or merged.
all_releases.reason: primary: document current league and unrecoverable historical states.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The live game is accessible, but exact historical league/balance states are not fully preservable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat Path of Exile 2 as a replacement for Path of Exile 1.
